command:
set -eu
backup=/var/backups/inventory/inventory-20260901.tar.gz
target=/srv/inventory/data/config.json
tmp=$(mktemp /srv/inventory/data/.config.json.restore.XXXXXX)
cleanup() { rm -f "$tmp"; }
trap cleanup 0 1 2 3 15
tar -xOzf "$backup" config.json > "$tmp"
python3 -m json.tool "$tmp" >/dev/null
chown --reference="$target" "$tmp"
chmod --reference="$target" "$tmp"
chcon --reference="$target" "$tmp"
sync "$tmp"
mv -fT "$tmp" "$target"
trap - 0 1 2 3 15
printf 'restored_from=%s\nrestored_target=%s\n' "$backup" "$target"
